description: Work out the card processing fees on a batch of card sales at the rates you send: a percent of the sales plus a fixed amount per transaction (for example 2.9% + 0.30). Send one line for one blended rate, or one line per card type (for example Visa credit, Amex, debit), each with its sales, number of transactions, percent and fixed fee, plus any flat fees for the batch. Get back the fee per line, the total fees, the net after fees, the effective rate (fees as a percent of sales), the average sale and the average fee per transaction. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/card-fee-calculator). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

flat_fees.description: Optional flat fees for the batch or the period (statement, batch or monthly fees), added once.

label.description: Optional label for the batch (your own text, echoed back; up to 6 digits in a row).

lines.description: One line per rate (one line for a blended rate; up to 50).

card_type.description: Optional name for the line, such as 'Visa credit' or 'blended' (your own text, echoed).

fixed_fee.description: Fixed fee per transaction (0.30 for 30 cents; up to 4 decimals; 0 if none).

percent_rate.description: Percent of sales charged (2.9 for 2.9%; up to 4 decimals).

sales_amount.description: Total card sales on this line (gross, before fees).

transactions.description: Number of card transactions on this line.

name: card_fee_calculator
title: Card Processing Fee Calculator
